text.en:
The last paragraph of section two of Act Numbered Thirty-four hundred and twenty-two, as
amended by Act Numbered Thirty-seven hundred, is hereby further amended to read as follows:
"And provided, further, That hawkers, peddlers, and hucksters who have secured licenses at the rates fixed by
ordinance in any municipality shall not be required to take out licenses in any other municipality through
which they may travel for business, unless the term for the renewal of such licenses shall have expired."

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, December 7, 1932.
